content: {"like":["Enjoys clever, irreverent humor in animated films like Ted and Puss in Boots","Values strong character arcs and realistic growth in anime such as Cowboy Bebop","Appreciates high-quality CGI and faithful adaptations in fantasy movies like Warcraft","Prefers well-executed special features and behind‑the‑scenes content in DVD releases","Enjoys chemistry-driven ensemble casts in supernatural dramas like Lucifer"],"dislike":["Dislikes offensive or crude humor that undermines comedy, as seen in Ted","Avoids content with graphic violence or mature themes for younger audiences, like Cowboy Bebop","Rejects low‑resolution video quality, exemplified by VHS‑style Puss in Boots","Dislikes theological deviations that alter core character dynamics, such as in Lucifer season two","Finds culturally insensitive or poorly developed protagonists off‑putting, as in The Big Sick"]}
